'''''Castle Creep''''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] popular amongst children of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] around the time in which [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] was growing up under the care of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], in approximately [[43 ABY]]. ''Castle Creep'' was an adventure story with vibrant characters such as [[dragon]]s. One dragon was named [[Perystal]], another character's name was [[Prince Gothik]].

[[Lando Calrissian, Junior|Lando Calrissian Jr.]], a friend of Allana's, also watched the holovid on a regular basis. Lando Jr. owned a toy of Perystal and Prince Gothik.
